records.text: Overlord Ramtusk is a named combatant whose cry invokes Agamaggan: “Victory! For Agamaggan!” His battle actions include Battle Shout and Thunderclap. That invocation gives his brief appearance a clear religious reference, while his known role centers on the fight.

Charlga Razorflank, called the Crone, treats the Kraul as her ground: she threatens outsiders for encroaching on the land and boasts that her power rules there. She expects new allies to avenge her side, and greets challengers with contempt. Her battle taunts make her defiant and protective of her cause.
Agathelos the Raging is a named beast whose frenzy marks its encounter, and it fights with Rampage. Its epithet and combat behavior distinguish this particular foe.
Aggem Thorncurse bears the title Death’s Head Prophet. In combat, he can cast Summon Boar Spirit. His title establishes a prophetic role.
Blind Hunter is a beast whose combat repertoire includes Shock.
A ward guardian whose combat role includes casting Fireball, giving it a command of fire magic.
Death Speaker Jargba is a Death's Head Captain whose combat magic includes Shadow Bolt and Dominate Mind.
A Razorfen warrior who uses Battle Shout in combat as part of its martial role.
A Razorfen quilguard that assumes a battle stance when engaged and slows nearby enemies with thunderclaps.
A Razorfen warden that uses a net in combat to restrain opponents.
A Razorfen spearhide that uses a thorn aura to harm those striking nearby allies and a whirling barrage against nearby enemies.
A Razorfen Kraul totemic fighter who uses a Healing Ward in combat, giving the role a healing function.
A Razorfen Kraul defender who uses Defensive Stance in combat, fitting a protective frontline role.

Willix is an entrepreneur who came to Razorfen Kraul seeking Blueleaf Tuber to sell to Mebok Mizzyrix, but was captured. During the escape, he points out Charlga Razorflank's lair, spots tuber as valuable, and warns of danger. He plans to return to Ratchet.

Heralath Fallowbrook is gravely ill and believes he is near death. In a final message, he says Lonebrow was sent to warn Falfindel, and asks that his stolen bonding pendant be returned to his wife, Treshala, in Darnassus along with word of his death.
Agam'ar is a Razorfen Kraul creature that charges into combat.
Rotting Agam'ar is a Razorfen Kraul creature that uses Cursed Blood in combat.
A large, aggressive Agam'ar that works itself into a frenzy when badly hurt.
A Death's Head Acolyte who fights with Mana Burn.
A Death's Head Adept who attacks with Frostbolt.
A Death's Head Priest who attacks with Shadow Bolt.
A Death's Head Sage who supports allies with a Healing Ward and an Elemental Protection Totem, and flees for help when badly hurt.
A Death's Head Seer who supports allies with a Healing Ward.
The Razorfen Geomancer summons an earth rumbler while out of combat.
The Razorfen Dustweaver summons a Wind Howler while out of combat and uses Enveloping Winds in combat.
The Razorfen Groundshaker uses Ground Tremor and Earth Shock in combat.
The Razorfen Earthbreaker uses Mind Tremor and Earth Shock in combat.
The Razorfen Handler summons a tamed battleboar while out of combat.
The Razorfen Beast Trainer summons a tamed battleboar, fights with shots including Frost Shot, and flees for help when critically hurt.
A Razorfen Beastmaster is a humanoid associated with Razorfen Kraul. Outside combat, it can cast Summon Tamed Hyena.
Kraul bats are creatures of Razorfen Kraul. This bat uses Shock when fighting, making it dangerous to approach as ordinary wildlife.
Greater Kraul bats are found in Razorfen Kraul. This bat uses Sonic Burst in combat, distinguishing it from the Kraul Bat’s Shock attack.
Known as Blood of Agamaggan, this creature is found in Razorfen Kraul and uses Curse of Blood in combat. Its name invokes Agamaggan.
A Quilguard Champion is a humanoid associated with Razorfen Kraul. In combat, it adopts Defensive Stance.
A Death’s Head Ward Keeper is a humanoid found in Razorfen Kraul. Outside combat, it performs Quillboar Channeling.
Earthcaller Halmgar is a named, powerful spellcaster. He can cast Summon Earth Rumbler while out of combat and Lightning Bolt in combat.
A Razorfen stalker is a stealthy combatant found in the Barrens. It casts Sneak outside combat.
Roogug is a named combatant found in the Barrens who casts Lightning Bolt in combat.

place_records.text: You are in Razorfen Kraul, a dungeon in The Barrens. Charlga Razorflank, called the Crone, claims the Kraul as her ground and threatens outsiders who encroach on it. Other masters here include Death's Head Prophet Aggem Thorncurse and Overlord Ramtusk. Razorfen Defenders and Raging Agam'ar fill the place, and Willix the Importer was once held prisoner here before he escaped.
